arStrings.szText: {c_important}Spear of the Heavens{/c} gains {c_number}[SF_36]{/c} initial spears that deal {c_number}{payload:SPEAR_BURST_IMPACT}{/c} damage per second for {c_number}{SF_15}{/c} seconds. These spears can be marked with {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c}.
{c_important}Spear of the Heavens{/c} now drops {c_number}{SF_16}{/c} spears along the path toward your target.

{c_important}Spear of the Heavens{/c} becomes a {c_Important}Core{/c} Skill and is now pure Holy energy that crashes down from the sky.

On impact it deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_FIST_IMPACT}{/c} damage and breaks into {c_number}{SF_25}{/c} projectiles, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_PROJ_PAYLOAD}{/c} additional damage to enemies in their path.
Consuming {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c} reduces {c_important}Spear of the Heavens{/c} active cooldown by {c_number}[SF_20|1|]{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Spear of the Heavens{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_40} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage against enemies affected by {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c}.
{c_important}Spear of the Heavens{/c} releases {c_number}{SF_43}{/c} additional projectiles after its 1st impact.
{c_important}Spear of the Heavens{/c} applies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} to enemies for {c_number}[SF_41]{/c} seconds.
